$comment: What every setting in this section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file. docs/configuration.md is generated from these (node scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs --write). See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

tickets.dir.does: The folder, inside the repository, where the story board's tickets are cached for the run.
tickets.dir.allowed: a folder relative to the repository

tickets.repo.does: The GitHub repository (`owner/name`) that holds the tickets.

tickets.assetsBranch.does: The branch the board publishes ticket assets (mockups, screenshots) to.

tickets.legacyDir.does: A folder of tickets in the older file format that `board migrate` reads.
tickets.legacyDir.allowed: a folder relative to the repository

tickets.spikeEpic.does: The epic `board migrate` files legacy research spikes under (`key`, `title`).

stateDir.does: The folder of the machine's own state: runs, logs, the ticket cache and the metrics spool (ignored by git).
stateDir.allowed: a folder relative to the repository

metricsDir.does: The folder of the agents' committed records, one file per branch and stream.
metricsDir.allowed: a folder relative to the repository

agentsDir.does: The folder of the base agent definitions inside the factory install.
agentsDir.allowed: a folder relative to the factory install

lessonsDir.does: The folder of the learned rules the retro writes for each agent.
lessonsDir.allowed: a folder relative to the repository

agentOverlayDir.does: The repository folder of the agent addenda (`<name>.md`) and replaced definitions (`<name>.agent.md`).
agentOverlayDir.allowed: a folder relative to the repository

baseRef.does: The branch diffs are taken against and new tickets start from.

implExclude.does: Paths that are never implementation (records, generated graphs): left out of diffs the verifiers and the PR check read.

bot.enabled.does: Opens and updates pull requests as the pipeline's PR bot instead of your own `gh` login.

bot.namePattern.does: The PR bot's name, with `{login}` replaced by the developer's login.

bot.credentialsDir.does: The folder of the PR bot's credentials on this machine.

storyGuard.enabled.does: Keeps agents from reading ticket folders other than the ones handed to their run.

storyGuard.folders.does: The folders of cached tickets the guard protects.

storyGuard.denyPaths.does: More paths no pipeline agent may read.

storyGuard.denyHosts.does: Network hosts no pipeline agent may reach (added to `FACTORY_GUARD_DENY_HOSTS`).

storyGuard.denyRepos.does: Repositories whose tickets no pipeline agent may read (added to `FACTORY_GUARD_DENY_REPOS`).

storyGuard.installReadable.does: Lets pipeline agents read the factory's own install.

storyGuard.networkOpen.does: Lets pipeline agents reach any network host the deny lists do not name.

agent.supervisor.idleSec.does: How long an agent may produce no output before the supervisor stops it as stalled.

agent.supervisor.ceilingFactor.does: How many times its normal time an agent that still makes progress may run before it is stopped.

agent.resultParseRetries.does: How many times an agent whose answer has no readable result is asked again for it.

agent.claude.promptCacheTtlSec.does: The prompt cache lifetime of a headless Claude Code run (an agent run is one short session): 300 or 3600, the two Claude Code offers.

agent.claude.toolSearch.does: Defers MCP tools behind Claude Code's ToolSearch instead of listing them to the agent directly.

agent.available.local.does: The agent CLIs this machine's developers have (recorded by `factory init`).

agent.available.ci.does: The agent CLIs that may run in CI (recorded by `factory init`).

recovery.startingGraceSec.does: How long a background run may take to start before it counts as dead.

factoryGuard.enabled.does: Stops pipeline agents from editing the factory's files in the repository.

factoryGuard.protected.does: Paths no pipeline agent may write; every file in the manifest is added.

factoryGuard.writers.does: The agents exempt from the factory guard.

council.blockQuorum.does: How many blocking members must object to a finding for it to block (no effect on a council of one).

council.onUnavailable.does: What a round does when a member cannot run: fail the round, or report it and go on without the member (a council of one always fails).

council.lateGraceSec.does: How long the PR check waits, after its last round, for a non-blocking member's late result.

council.members.does: How many members a council seats, from `models.pool`; 1 seats the stage's own verifier alone. Each stage section's `councilMembers` overrides it.

council.explorationSeat.enabled.does: With two or more seats, reserves one seat for the eligible pool entry with the fewest seats in the stage (by the scorecard), so models it knows little about are still tried; the family rule still applies.

council.shadowSeat.enabled.does: With one seat, adds a second, non-blocking member from another model family: its findings are feedback, its score never decides and the stage does not wait for it; beside the PR check's critic panel it is one more critic. It doubles the verifier runs of a one-seat council.

council.scorecard.minSeats.does: The seats a model needs in a lens and stage before its scorecard row has numbers; a row with fewer is unknown, neither good nor bad for selection.

council.scorecard.weights.prCheckRuling.does: The weight of a PR check judge ruling (an upheld finding) in a scorecard row's score.

council.scorecard.weights.miss.does: The weight of a miss (a problem found after the council passed: a PR check upheld finding, a red CI check) in a scorecard row's score.

council.scorecard.weights.ledToChange.does: The weight of a pair or verifier stage finding that led to a change in a scorecard row's score.

council.scorecard.weights.lowWeightMiss.does: The weight of a lower-weight miss (a human "changes requested" review, a later bug ticket) in a scorecard row's score.

orchestrator.model.does: The `models.pool` entry every stage's orchestrator runs on: it decides whether to do the stage's producing work itself or delegate it, and it never verifies its own work.

orchestrator.effort.does: The orchestrators' reasoning effort (`null`: the pool entry's own).

council.intercom.enabled.does: Lets a council's members discuss their first round with each other before the merge.

council.intercom.host.does: The address the discussion room listens on.
council.intercom.host.allowed: a host name or IP address

council.intercom.port.does: The port the discussion room listens on (0 picks a free one).

council.intercom.advertiseHost.does: The address members on other machines reach the room at.
council.intercom.advertiseHost.allowed: a host name or IP address, not a wildcard

council.intercom.allowInsecureRemote.does: Allows a room on a non-loopback address, with plain-HTTP bearer tokens on the network.

council.intercom.maxTurnsPerMember.does: How many messages each member may post in a discussion.

council.intercom.maxEscalations.does: How many split questions a discussion may escalate.

council.intercom.onSplit.does: Who rules when the members' discussion splits.

retro.factory.enabled.does: Lets the retro propose changes to the factory itself, as a branch pushed to `source`.

retro.factory.source.does: The repository the retro's factory proposal branch is pushed to.

retro.factory.allowedPaths.does: The factory folders a retro proposal may touch.

retro.factory.evidence.does: How much of this repository's run data the factory proposal quotes.

metrics.sink.type.does: Where agent run records go besides the local files.

metrics.sink.path.does: The shared folder a `directory` sink writes to.

metrics.sink.url.does: The collector a `http` sink posts to.

metrics.sink.endpoint.does: The OpenTelemetry logs endpoint an `otlp` sink posts to.

metrics.sink.headers.does: HTTP headers of an `http` or `otlp` sink (`${NAME}` references for secrets).

metrics.sink.push.does: The command a `command` sink pushes records with.

metrics.sink.pull.does: The command a `command` sink reads records back with.

metrics.sink.streams.does: More metrics streams to ship besides the pipeline's own.

metrics.sink.scope.does: On a readable sink, `all` lets the retro read every project in the store.

experiment.testCmd.does: The command a delivery experiment runs a pooled e2e spec with (`{file}` is the spec).

experiment.testTimeoutSec.does: How long one pooled e2e spec of an experiment may run.

project.name.does: Names machine-wide state (stack project, language server sockets), so two repositories on one machine never collide.

project.toolPaths.does: Folders added to `PATH` for every command and agent the pipeline starts.

project.services.does: The buildable units: their paths, unit tests and dependencies; drives subtask planning, unit tests, stack rebuilds and the review gate's systems.

project.services[].paths.does: The paths that belong to a service.

project.services[].unitTests.does: Where a service's unit tests are (`{project}` in `implement.unitTests.cmd`).

project.services[].testProjects.does: Other test projects that cover a service.

project.services[].dependsOn.does: The services a service depends on.

project.services[].partOf.does: The one service a library belongs to.

project.services[].ui.does: Marks a library that holds user interface components.

host.does: The code host the factory acts on; [providers](providers/README.md) lists each one's keys.

host.type.does: Which code host the repository is on.
host.type.defaultText: detected from the `origin` remote; `github` without one

host.url.does: The code host's base URL (set it for a self-hosted server).

host.repo.does: The repository on the code host (GitHub `owner/name`, GitLab the project path, Azure DevOps `organization/project/repository`, Bitbucket `workspace/repository`).

host.user.does: Bitbucket only: the `${NAME}` of the account for an API token or app password.

host.token.does: The environment variable holding the code host's token, never the token (GitHub uses the `gh` login).

host.command.does: The command of a `custom` code host adapter.

host.env.does: Variables for a `custom` adapter's process (`${NAME}` references).

host.timeoutSec.does: How long one call of a `custom` adapter may take.

host.capabilities.does: What a `custom` code host adapter can do.

tracker.does: The ticket tracker the factory acts on; [providers](providers/README.md) lists each one's keys.

tracker.type.does: Which ticket tracker holds the tickets.

tracker.project.does: The tracker's project (Jira key, Azure DevOps project, GitLab path, Linear team key).

tracker.auth.does: The tracker's credentials as `${NAME}` references (`user` and `token`, or `token`).

tracker.board.does: The tracker's board the pipeline moves tickets on.

tracker.lanes.does: The pipeline's lanes mapped to the tracker's statuses or columns.

tracker.types.does: The pipeline's ticket types mapped to the tracker's types.

tracker.fields.does: The pipeline's fields (severity, impact, ...) mapped to the tracker's field ids or names.

tracker.command.does: The command of a `custom` tracker adapter.

tracker.env.does: Variables for a `custom` adapter's process (`${NAME}` references).

tracker.timeoutSec.does: How long one call of a `custom` adapter may take.

tracker.capabilities.does: What a `custom` tracker adapter can do.

ci.does: The CI system the factory renders jobs for and reads results from; [providers](providers/README.md) lists each one's keys.
ci.defaultText: the code host's own CI system

ci.provider.does: Which CI system runs the factory's jobs.

ci.user.does: The CI account (Jenkins), as a `${NAME}` reference.

ci.token.does: The CI API token, as a `${NAME}` reference.

ci.expected.does: The pipelines a head must run, instead of the ones derived from the CI system.

ci.command.does: The command of a `custom` CI adapter.

ci.env.does: Variables for a `custom` adapter's process (`${NAME}` references).

ci.timeoutSec.does: How long one call of a `custom` adapter may take.

ci.capabilities.does: What a `custom` CI adapter can do.

analysis.does: Static analysis, opt-in: `{}` turns on the security pack and the packs of `project.languages` ([analysis](ai-pipeline/analysis.md)); its own validator checks every key.

analysis.tools.does: The analysis tools, as data; `null` turns a pack's tool off.

analysis.suppressions.does: Inline suppression patterns listed for the members as suppressions to justify.

analysis.protect.does: More paths the factory guard protects while analysis is on.

analysis.coverage.does: Coverage of the added production lines, evidence for the `test-value` lens, never a gate.

analysis.ci.does: The analysis CI jobs rendered for the CI system (`enabled`, `jobs`).

analysis.ci.jobs[].timeoutSec.does: How long one static analysis CI job may run.

analysis.coverageTimeoutSec.does: How long the coverage run (`analysis.coverage`) may take when it names no `timeoutSec` of its own.

analysis.maxConcurrent.does: How many analysis tools run at once on the machine.

analysis.acceptLicence.does: A person's acceptance of a tool licence outside the allowlist.

analysis.licenceReview.does: `strict` turns off every tool enabled pending legal review.

analysis.secrets.does: Values a person declares are not secrets (`allow.stopwords`, `allow.regexes`).

analysis.commercial.does: A licensed scanner, or a list of them ([commercial scanners](providers/commercial-scanners.md)).
analysis.commercial.allowed: an object or a list of objects

analysis.commercial.timeoutSec.does: How long the gate waits for a licensed scanner's result on a head (each entry of a list has its own).

policy.does: New services for the architecture policy, declared in app.json only ([architecture policy](architecture-policy.md)); never merged into the settings.

recovery.maxRetries.does: How many times a background run that died (test writing, PR check, review) is restarted.

recovery.retryDelaySec.does: How long to wait before the first restart of a dead background run; the wait doubles each time.

analysis.maxFixRounds.does: How many times static analysis findings are handed back for fixing within one round of verification (and at ticket level).

retro.enabled.does: Runs the retro that reviews the agents' recorded decisions and proposes fixes.

project.frontendPaths.does: Which files count as user interface: screen checks, design review and demo videos apply only to changes here.

project.testRoots.does: The folders where tests live; with `implExclude` it separates implementation from tests.

hooks.codeAgents.does: Which agents, when they finish, start the architecture review and the automatic PR check.

retro.allowedPaths.does: Which repository folders the retro may propose changes to.

retro.windowDays.does: How far back the retro looks when it has never run before.

retro.intervalDays.does: How often the lessons and the retro run when started as "if due".

retro.lessons.storyThreshold.does: A rule is added when a denial category recurs in this many tickets and no rule covers it.

retro.lessons.maxRules.does: The most rules a lessons file keeps.

retro.lessons.retireAfterStories.does: A rule is retired when its category has not recurred for this many tickets.

retro.lessons.revertMinRounds.does: A rule is reverted when, after this many verifier rounds, its category's denial rate did not drop.

retro.lessons.examplesPerCategory.does: Examples per category in the digest the retro agent reads.
